reuse.why: Selects categories through the existing getVisibleCategoriesWithoutTemplates helper shared by the other month-wide actions and reads spending with getSheetValue/sheetForMonth; setBudget, batchMessages and mutator(undoable) are reused.

duplication.why: Repeats the income-skip check and the expense sign flip that each sibling action inlines rather than sharing them.

placement.why: The action is in budget/actions.ts next to its siblings and registered in budget/app.ts with the same wrapping.

scope.why: Besides the new action and test, it removes an unrelated income-cat insert from the copyUntilYearEnd test setup and adds an unformatted test block.

maintainability.why: Small and consistent with sibling actions, though the copied per-action income rule and sign handling keep spreading.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses the shared category selection and setBudget like the other month-wide actions.

disguised_duplication.where: The income-skip and sign logic are copied openly (sign written as a ternary rather than avg *= -1, but plainly the same rule).
